competitive_scope.name: Cloud cost optimization and FinOps
competing_capabilities: FinOps reporting and cloud spend optimization
competitive_scope.decision_rule: Treat a vendor as a competing service when supported evidence shows that it sells one or more core competing capabilities. Cloud usage alone is not competitive overlap.

country_policy.basis: Fixed country screen required by this exercise
country_policy.scope: Flags verified registered, contracting, parent, or operational-headquarters jurisdictions in Belarus, Iran, North Korea, or Russia for this exercise only
country_policy.decision_rule: Multiple locations are not a conflict unless sources disagree about the same entity and role. A listed-country office requires review but is not by itself a flag.
country_policy.exclusions: Not a complete OFAC, export-control, ownership, person, or entity screen. Cuba and other active sanctions programs are outside the fixed exercise set.
